propositions: Plan-review gate has no criterion to detect whether a proposed change is actually needed (FixedBench over-action gap); a new advisory 'necessity' criterion should flag plans that add mechanisms without establishing motivation or reproduction.

Bug tickets currently short-circuit to bare exempt-PASS with zero substantive review; the plan-review gate should run a lightweight advisory tier (DET floor + necessity probe) for bugs instead of exempting them entirely.
The necessity probe must apply to bug tickets (no suppress_types suppression for bug) and accept well-motivated outcomes (reproduction + motivation) or justified no-ops (docs/test-only changes).

Bug-tier implementation reuses existing advisory-criterion seam: restrict LLM criteria to BUG_TIER_CRITERIA=("necessity",), downgrade DET findings to advisory (det_blocking=[]), and preserve claim-gate exemption (no signed attestation required to claim a bug).

Both advisory criteria (necessity and bug tier) auto-flow into standing effectiveness recorder without additional wiring and remain advisory until operator-attested promotion via effectiveness metrics (high detection_proxy, low blocking_fp_proxy).
